title: Chicago: home street
action: Eye height 1.65 m, slow 2 m push along a mapped home block; brick bungalow and flats anchor scale.
evidence: Mapped footprints, curb, frontage and building heights must be checked. Shared mid-afternoon master.

title: Sun: earlier key
action: Lock the home camera; begin a controlled time sweep from earlier sun. Keep geometry fixed.
evidence: Capture solar response in engine; show actual capture date and time range. No painted dissolve.

title: Sun: shadow travel
action: Continue the fixed camera into later sun; shadow crosses the same curb.
evidence: Artwork is a directional sketch; final engine cameras must register exactly. No added golden grade.

title: Rain arrives
action: Hold the same Chicago block; cloud cover reduces direct light, sparse rain starts before wetness builds.
evidence: Engine weather transition, labeled controlled. Live weather requires dated observations. rain-v1 overrides clear sky.

title: Street becomes wet
action: Lower to curb height. Show distinct asphalt, concrete and lawn responses; hold a dry-to-wet boundary.
evidence: Capture engine materials and persistent wetness. Restrained broken sheen, no mirror roads or invented splashes.

title: Night: home block
action: Return to the home framing. Sparse warm windows and localized lamp pools with dark gaps.
vo: At night, the block stays readable.
evidence: Use night-fog-v1 dry night: readable cool fill, 20–40% eligible windows as art target. Occupancy is illustrative.

title: Chicago: live train
action: Oblique elevated rail camera, generic unbranded train moving on mapped tracks.
evidence: Fresh source positions and data age required. Hand-keyframed motion cannot be labeled live; stale feed becomes labeled replay.

title: Chicago: region
action: Pull above lakefront to metropolitan region. Match cut if continuous flight is unsupported.
evidence: Engine renders region geometry. Editorial cut and scale labels allowed. Explicit afternoon reset; do not imply seamless flight if cut.

title: Denver: home street
action: Match Chicago curb height and lens. Use W 23rd Avenue visual reference; confirm mapped capture location.
evidence: Shared afternoon master and Denver archetypes. Validate footprints, setbacks and heights; no oversized mountains.

title: Denver: transit
action: Rise to a mapped rail corridor and hold one moving train against stable geometry.
evidence: Verified Denver route/feed required. If unavailable label replay and revise live narration. Same afternoon exposure.

title: Miami: home street
action: Palm-height drift past one-story stucco homes, tile and low-slope roof variants.
evidence: Shared afternoon master and Miami archetypes. True scale requires measured engine geometry; artwork cannot prove it.

title: Miami: rain state
action: Hold the same curb and frontage as rain starts; road and sidewalk develop subtle wetness.
evidence: Engine material transition required. rain-v1 surface formula once, darkening capped at 12%; no post-added weather claim.

title: Creator kit: course
action: Clear afternoon reset. Top-down mapped Miami street; cursor places route vertices and cyan line follows the road.
vo: Draw a course on a real street.
evidence: World, georeferencing and actual course placement must work in engine. Editor chrome may be mocked only with Concept interface label.

title: Creator kit: village
action: Same site. Place tents and barriers in adjacent mapped lot; rotate and nudge one tent, then tilt to low oblique.
vo: Place the event village beside it.
evidence: Assets, transforms, grounding and persistence must render in engine. Layout is conceptual, not event approval. Blank tents, no people.

title: Globe: satellite layer
action: Match cut through region to globe. Fine orbit line and dot with source epoch; small city locators.
vo: See it in the wider world.
evidence: Engine globe and coordinate anchoring required. Satellite position calculated from dated orbital elements, not directly observed. Overlay may use identical coordinates.

title: Close: home again
action: Return to Miami home street, shared afternoon. Settle motion, plain text WorldEngine; final 2-second hold.
evidence: Engine street required; editorial typography permitted. No logo. Closing line must be selected before release.
